news.title: U.S. Fed Governor Waller pitches keeping central bank at the center of tokenization
news.summary: Waller suggested the Federal Reserve could provide trusted rails for emerging innovation tied to tokenized assets and agentic AI.

news.title: Bitcoin drops 2.5% as Nvidia stock risks new 5-month lows into Q3 earnings
news.summary: Bitcoin price downside sees local lows of $63,269 as Nvidia stock targets $150 as traders brace for volatility over Q3 earnings.

news.title: Alpaca says tokenization network tops $10 billion in minting and redemption volume
news.summary: Alpaca co-founder Hitoshi Harada said its Instant Tokenization Network has surpassed $10 billion in cumulative minting and redemption volume.

news.title: Anchorage, Kalshi Prime let institutions use custodied bitcoin as margin
news.summary: Anchorage clients can pledge bitcoin and stablecoins held at its federally chartered bank as margin on Kalshi Prime's CFTC-regulated venue.

news.title: Hong Kong, Swift test tokenized deposits as banks chase stablecoin-style speed
news.summary: Hong Kong and Swift expanded their efforts to connect tokenized bank deposits across currencies, building on earlier work involving digital central bank money.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Solana Foundation takes majority interest in crypto data firm CoinGecko
news.summary: Solana Foundation now holds a majority interest in CoinGecko, its product chief said, as the crypto data platform explores trading features.

news.title: Solana’s Trump memecoin launch tested infrastructure ahead of institutional push, Lily Liu says
news.summary: Liu recapped two periods of trading as evidence Solana's network can withstand pressure from unpredictable crypto markets.

news.title: Bitwise launches ZDAY, its first non-crypto ETF, to bet on AI cyber defense
news.summary: Bitwise's first non-crypto ETF, ZDAY, trades on the NYSE with a 0.75% fee, holding 10–30 AI security stocks like CrowdStrike and Palo Alto.

news.title: Bernstein sees upside for bitcoin miners Riot and TeraWulf, citing discounts to implied AI data center values
news.summary: Riot's AI leases imply twice its adjusted enterprise value, Bernstein estimates, with TeraWulf also trading at a discount.

news.title: Bitcoin to $1M by 2030? ‘Almost certainly not,’ says Dragonfly’s Qureshi
news.summary: Dragonfly’s Haseeb Qureshi says Bitcoin could reach $400,000 by 2030 but doubts it will return to $100,000 by year-end with the rout in AI stocks weighing on crypto.

news.title: ARK sells $85M in Nvidia shares ahead of chipmaker’s Q3 earnings results
news.summary: ARK bought shares in Block, Circle and Coinbase worth about $39.9 million at Monday’s close while selling Nvidia and Solana and Ether staking ETFs.

news.title: Stablecoin infrastructure firm Avenia raises $25 million in Series A extension
news.summary: Lightspeed Faction led the equity round, bringing Avenia's total funding to $44.6 million as it plans new products and acquisitions.

news.title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade risks breaking up to 15,000 automated apps
news.summary: In addition to that broader estimate, independent audits have uncovered hundreds of separate compatibility problems, with core developers set to reconsider the changes Thursday.

news.title: Decentralized exchange Grvt looks to makes commodity trading more predictable with stable funding perps
news.summary: Grvt’s new Stable Funding Perps tie the cost of holding commodities trades to traditional-market financing costs, rather than volatile crypto-style funding.

news.title: Grvt launches RWA perpetuals with funding tied to traditional markets
news.summary: Grvt’s Stable Funding Perps debut across seven commodity markets, with funding rates linked to market makers’ financing costs.

news.title: Revolut plans four blockchain-based funds for private markets, chair says
news.summary: Citing a looming liquidity crunch, Martin Gilbert said blockchain could help bring more liquidity to private markets.

news.title: Crypto's 'casino-chips' are disappearing, adding to pain from spot ETF outflows
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 17, 2026

news.title: Ex-OpenAI researcher fund dumps bitcoin miners, cuts IREN 94% after portfolio slump
news.summary: The fund swapped its common stock in Bloom Energy, Nebius and SanDisk for call options, keeping its bet on AI power, computing and memory.

news.title: Lighter reopens withdrawals after trader’s API key leak, returns about $5 million in USDC
news.summary: Lighter reopened deposits and withdrawals and said it returned about $5 million in USDC to the affected trader.

news.title: Bitcoin remains penned in near $64,000 even as ETF outflow streak ends
news.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is down a further 1.0% since midnight UTC at around $64,200, with its bounce from the weekend selloff stalled and pressure building on all fronts.

news.title: US senators seek SEC answers on tokenized stock money laundering risks
news.summary: Four Democratic senators asked who would be responsible for tokenized shares transferred outside regulated platforms and whether the SEC could freeze or recover those tokens.

news.title: Solana Foundation takes majority stake in crypto data provider CoinGecko
news.summary: The foundation plans Solana-powered trading on CoinGecko's website, GeckoTerminal and app.

news.title: New DeFi-yield generation targets ‘scam-like’ bank accounts that keep all the interest
news.summary: Crypto native firms like Animoca Brands are betting AI-based agentic commerce to style every area of finance with the so-called “DeFi mullet”

news.title: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF snaps $2.35B outflow streak amid extreme fear
news.summary: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF ended 11 sessions of withdrawals totaling $2.35 billion, but CryptoQuant says one day of inflows is too early to signal a recovery.

news.title: Bitcoin realized loss metric beats June high as open interest eyes 2-year low
news.summary: Bitcoin short-term holders’ onchain spending notched the largest proportion of realized losses since February after BTC/USD dropped to $62,000.

news.title: Former Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to wire fraud over trades ahead of crypto listing announcements
news.summary: A former Robinhood engineer faces up to 20 years after admitting to profiting from Hyperliquid trades ahead of crypto listing announcements.

news.title: Fed Governor Michael Barr warns AI agents could trigger bank runs in minutes
news.summary: In a speech at an AI event in Italy, Barr said automated financial decisions could overwhelm banks and raises concerns about AI systems bypassing security controls.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin and stocks continue slump as Huang signals interest in returning to Nvidia
news.summary: The Fed's hawkish rhetoric continued on Tuesday, with St. Louis Fed President Musalem arguing for several rate hikes before next spring. Homebuilder confidence fell to a 14-year low.

news.title: Hackers plant crypto-stealing code on 178 major websites, including HSBC and Ledger
news.summary: An Optimizely signup flaw let an attacker plant address-swapping code on websites including HSBC, the BBC and Ledger. The total stolen remains unknown, and investigators have not linked the attack to AI.

news.title: Tether Capital invests $15 million in Nomad, eyes wider access to USDT and XAUT in Brazil
news.summary: Tether said the deal could ease international payments in Brazil and open the door to USDT and Tether Gold integrations.

news.title: Nvidia faces first earnings test without Jensen Huang as AI stocks slide
news.summary: With shares almost 40% below their October peak, Nvidia’s guidance could carry more weight than quarterly results as investors assess its direction without Jensen Huang.

news.title: Google says hackers use AI agents to find and exploit software flaws
news.summary: Google says attackers are using AI agents to find and exploit software flaws automatically, reducing the time organizations have to apply patches.

news.title: US judge clears brothers in $25M Ethereum MEV case after mistrial
news.summary: Judge Jessica Clarke said the transactions did not involve false promises, but the ruling did not determine whether the brothers’ conduct was ethical or violated other laws.

news.title: Binance hacker moves $63 million in stolen ether after 2 weeks of silence
news.summary: North Korea's TraderTraitor group transferred 34,279 ETH to three new wallets. The funds have not moved again, blockchain investigators say.

news.title: Goldman Sachs reports $1.22B in Ether ETFs as ETHA share count jumps
news.summary: Goldman Sachs increased its Ether ETF shares in Q3, bringing its reported holdings to $1.22 billion, while reshuffling its Bitcoin ETF positions.

news.title: Grayscale says crypto pullback offers ‘compelling entry points’ as bitcoin falls to $64,000
news.summary: Grayscale Head of Research Zach Pandl said crypto still has strong fundamental demand, such as institutional adoption of stablecoins.

news.title: Bitcoin could slide into the $50,000s as Fed rate hike bets build, Wintermute says
news.summary: Bitcoin may slide into the $50,000s after losing its 200-week average, with ETF outflows, weak demand and rate-hike risks weighing on BTC, leading market maker warns.

news.title: Cardano Foundation seeks $5 million from treasury using ADA price 33% above market
news.summary: The Foundation wants 25 million ADA for 12 global events, even as the token trades well below the 20 cent price used to size the request.

news.title: Ex-Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to $125K Hyperliquid trading scheme
news.summary: The former Robinhood engineer used confidential information about upcoming Robinhood token listings to trade on Hyperliquid.

news.title: Cathie Wood’s Ark Invest loads up on crypto stocks while selling $85 million in Nvidia
news.summary: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest bought additional shares in Block Inc., Circle, and Coinbase as the stocks traded lower on Monday.

news.title: CZ denies Binance sold crypto, Bitwise sees Solana at $1,100 by 2031, and more
news.summary: In today's newsletter, CZ denies Binance sold crypto as bitcoin rebounds from four-month low; Bitwise sees Solana reaching $1,100 by 2031 in bull case; and more.

news.title: Wells Fargo's reported BlackRock bitcoin ETF holdings double to $2.35 billion
news.summary: The bank's reported BlackRock bitcoin ETF position doubled to $2.35 billion in the third quarter, giving it exposure to roughly 28,000 BTC.

news.title: Ripple-backed Evernorth has written down its pre-listing XRP holdings by 60%
news.summary: The company’s accounting policy requires it to record price declines without reversing those write-downs when XRP recovers.

news.title: Trezor customer data exposed in 3rd partner breach this year
news.summary: Trezor warned an attacker has been able to access customer names, phone numbers and delivery addresses linked to 27,000 orders from one of its shipping providers.

news.title: Hackers inject credit card, crypto-stealing malware into 178 major websites
news.summary: Ledger and Coinpass were among the businesses whose websites served malware designed to steal visitors’ crypto and credit card details, according to security researchers.

news.title: Nvidia shares fall 4% as board reportedly rules out Huang return
news.summary: The chipmaker’s board is reportedly focused on investigating Huang’s conduct, even as a petition calling for his reinstatement gathers more than 187,000 signatures.

news.title: CFTC backs blockchain-based derivatives infrastructure as Backpack, tZERO win approvals
news.summary: The CFTC has approved the first set of applications to establish regulated derivatives and exchange clearing operations that use blockchain.

news.title: Custodia Bank loses Supreme Court bid for direct Fed payment access
news.summary: The Supreme Court refused to hear Custodia Bank’s appeal, meaning a lower court ruling allowing the Fed to reject account applications will stand.

news.title: German lawmakers back crypto freezes outside criminal cases
news.summary: Customs authorities could hold “suspicious” assets for 30 days under the bill, with court oversight for extensions and disputed confiscation.

news.title: Binance hack may push institutions to outside custody, FalconX exec says
news.summary: FalconX’s Joshua Lim says the Binance hack could push institutions to keep crypto off exchanges and change how large investors trade in 2027.

news.title: Former Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to insider trading scheme on Hyperliquid
news.summary: Huaisong Xiang admitted using confidential crypto listing information to make $125,523 trading perpetual futures on Hyperliquid.

news.title: Trezor hit by another shipping partner data leak, affecting 27,000 Skladon orders
news.summary: Trezor warns of scam calls and physical security risks after customer addresses leak at shipping partner.

news.title: Bitmine edges toward 5% of ETH supply as treasuries report buys amid market slump
news.summary: Strategy, Strive, Bitmine and Cypherpunk disclosed fresh additions to their crypto treasuries, spanning Bitcoin, Ether and Zcash.

news.title: Democratic senators warn SEC’s tokenized stock exemption has illicit finance gaps
news.summary: Four Democratic senators are raising concerns about the Securities and Exchange Commission's newly unveiled innovation exemption.

news.title: Bitcoin risks falling below $60,000 as Nvidia earnings threaten to deepen crypto selloff
news.summary: Rising bond yields, ETF outflows and forced selling are weighing on bitcoin as traders brace for more losses.

news.title: Peraire-Bueno brothers acquitted of wire fraud in $25 million Ethereum MEV case
news.summary: A judge acquitted the Peraire-Bueno brothers of wire fraud over the Ethereum MEV exploit, ruling prosecutors showed no misrepresentation.

news.title: Bitwise sees Solana reaching $1,100 by 2031 in bull case as onchain trading grows
news.summary: Bitwise predicts the SOL token will be valued at $1,100 by 2031, versus $385 in the base case and $80 in the bear case.

news.title: Boris Johnson says UK must lead blockchain development despite crypto doubts
news.summary: Johnson was joined by Lord Ross Kempsell who called for regulators to work with industry participants to bring the UK to the forefront.

news.title: Coinbase and Broadridge propose standard for tokenized stock disclosures
news.summary: The proposed standard aims to connect tokenized stockholders with corporate disclosures and voting materials across digital wallets, but would not create shareholder rights.

news.title: Solflare CEO says AI security reviews are essential, touts ‘bunker mode’ and MoneyGram deal
news.summary: Vidor Gencel says AI catches chained exploits humans miss, and details the wallet's "bunker mode," privacy mode, and MoneyGram USDC cash-out.

news.title: U.S. Senate Democrats tell CFTC to back off its demand prediction markets defy bans
news.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission directed platforms such as Kalshi to defy state bans, but the Democrats want it to reverse course, citing court orders.

news.title: Winklevoss-backed Cypherpunk buys Zcash dip as mining debut delivers $2.6 million operating profit
news.summary: Since quarter-end, Cypherpunk bought another 3,775 ZEC for about $3.5 million at an average price of $920.40.

news.title: Nvidia turmoil tests Bitcoin miners’ AI funding plans
news.summary: Nvidia’s leadership upheaval and Texas permit restrictions sharpen the divide between miners with funded projects and those still seeking capital and approvals.

news.title: Safe wallet reportedly loses $6.5M as Zodiac suspects key compromise
news.summary: Zodiac’s co-founder said a likely compromised key and overly permissive wallet settings enabled the theft, rather than a flaw in its smart contracts.

news.title: Lighter suspends all withdrawals after $10.4 million crypto exploit
news.summary: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

news.title: Bitcoin price fails to hold $65K as US stocks drop further on AI nerves
news.summary: Bitcoin and US equities saw pressure to start the week as traders weighed the impact of forthcoming Nvidia Q3 earnings and Anthropic’s IPO announcement.

news.title: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks
news.summary: A central bank official reportedly said legitimate funds become tainted when moved into stablecoins, comparing the market to the informal "dólar-cabo" system.

news.title: German parliament proposes crypto seizures without criminal charges
news.summary: German lawyers said a proposed law allowing the seizure of assets worth more than 100,000 euros could impose a burden of proof on crypto holders rather than the authorities.

news.title: Solana drops ‘beta’ label after more than six years
news.summary: The blockchain is getting a shared version number. Wallets, transactions and apps remain unchanged.
